entries.reason: Distinct local references may have zero distance when they induce the same Ref(.) equivalence class.
entries.equivalence_behavior: d_Omega(a,b)=0 when a and b induce the same Ref(.) equivalence class under the active O family.
boundedness_conditions: declared residue context when equivalence class changes
entries.degeneracy_behavior: set-valued references are compared by minimum, maximum, or Hausdorff-style distance over their induced equivalence classes; exact choice remains implementation-dependent.
claim_limits: not yet a full metric proof
may be pseudometric until equivalence-class quotient is formalized

quotient_spaces.definition: The quotient space formed by identifying local references that induce the same admissibility-preserving continuation class under the active O family.

usage_rules.name: bounded_ref_divergence_rule_v1
usage_rules.statement: Reference divergence is bounded when d_Omega between induced local references remains below a declared tolerance τ under active admissibility and residue context.

usage_rules.name: degenerate_reference_distance_rule_v1
usage_rules.statement: Distance between set-valued -(i) references must preserve degeneracy rather than collapse to a single representative unless a tie-breaking rule is declared.
